Cadastral map covering Panama Canal between K.46 and K.59. "June 1907." Title from accompanying index map. Blueprint. Issued as loose-leaf text. Accompanied by index map. (1 map : photocopy ; 58 x 85 cm.) Map no. A192, A193(1), A194(2), A195(3), A196(4), A197(5), A198(6), A199(7), A200(8), A201(9), A202(10), A203(11), A204(12), A205(13), A206(14), A207(15), A208(15 1/2), A209(16), A210(17), A211(18), and A212(19). Annotated in yellow pencil on every sheet: 19-6. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Transferred from the collection of the Canal Zone Library-Museum, 1980.
